content.comment_body: Does the [product_name] [article_no] support communication with OPC (OLE for Process Control)?

analysis.insight_summary: The user is inquiring whether the [product_name] [article_no] hardware allows connectivity with OPC (OLE for Process Control) systems. The main focus is on integration and compatibility between the [company_name] device and widely used industry protocols. Unclear documentation and lack of quick feedback contribute to user uncertainty regarding protocol support, potentially influencing trust in the product’s integration capabilities.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the [product_name] [article_no] module to support OPC communication or, at the very least, to have clear information available about its compatibility with OPC systems.
